whatItIs.statement: A governed, finite Lucide SVG icon with inherited color by default, bounded semantic color options, and no arbitrary SVG, className, style or children API.

whenToUse.statement: Use Icon for decorative symbols alongside text, navigation indicators, and icon-only actions composed inside a named Button. Use Spinner for an animated loading indicator; Icon loader is static.

howToUse.statement: Choose a required name from the bounded Icon contract. size is sm (14px), default (16px), or lg (20px), derived from the spacing unit; default is 16px.

Icon is decorative by default and has aria-hidden=true. If its standalone meaning needs an accessible name, use <Icon name="info" decorative={false} label="Information" />. The label must contain non-whitespace text; meaningful icons render role=img.
An icon-only Button must have an action name, for example <Button size="icon" aria-label="Search"><Icon name="search" /></Button>. Keep the Icon decorative to avoid duplicate announcements.

Use placement="inline-start" or placement="inline-end" within Button to write the governed data-icon marker for inline spacing and Button loading composition. Icon placement follows the order of its siblings; it does not move the icon automatically.

options.statement: Logical arrow-start, arrow-end, chevron-start and chevron-end mirror automatically in RTL. Physical left/right/up/down identities and panel-left remain fixed. Choose logical identities for reading-direction navigation.

color defaults to inherit, preserving surrounding text and interactive component foregrounds. Choose foreground, primary, muted-foreground or destructive to use existing light/dark semantic tokens. Explicit colors must contrast with their surrounding surface; use inherit inside colored Buttons. Do not communicate meaning by color alone: retain visible text or a meaningful label. Icon exposes no arbitrary color string, interactions or link semantics.
